title: Train robbery (synthetic, SFW)
premise: A night train crosses the desert. Mara and Brick sit in the dining car when a masked robber bursts in. Non-graphic action; nobody is seriously hurt.

R001.name: Dining Car
R001.description: The dining car sways along the night rails. Booths of cracked green leather line both walls under swinging brass lamps, and the windows show only dark desert.

gemini_notes: Keep the action PG-13 and non-graphic. Mara is a cautious traveler; Brick is her gruff travelling companion.
